proposal.description: An overcurrent window trip during soft start only pauses the promotion to S_RUN and keeps the FSM ramping in S_SS, as if high current while the output capacitor charges were expected, instead of sending the converter into the S_HICCUP cool-down
proposal.reason: When window_trip_SS rises in S_SS, state_out stays at S_SS, ss_active and en stay high and hiccup_active never rises, so the gate drive keeps switching into the overcurrent. The FSM moves on to S_RUN once the soft-start window count falls below trip_ss while SS_done is high, so no cool-down or strike is ever taken.
